attributes.name: Blessing of the Neverfull
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to draw a card from your discard pile.

Recharge this card and bury another card to draw a card.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessing discard pile has the Venkelvore trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
